item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00795","case1_error":"Changes four aunts to three and replaces the attending brother with Iris.","case2_error":"Subtracts four claws for the exceptional parrot instead of adding its one extra claw to the baseline total.","reason":"The first alters stated attendee counts; the second incorrectly adjusts a correctly calculated baseline for an exception.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00796","case1_error":"Uses the final tank population as the initial population when calculating fish caught.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 476 − 75 as 391 instead of 401.","reason":"The first uses the wrong temporal quantity in its relation; the second makes a numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00797","case1_error":"Introduces an unsupported $3,000 tax expense; 20% of the $5,000 pretax profit is $1,000.","case2_error":"Divides the company's remaining funds by ten instead of dividing the correctly calculated wage pool by ten.","reason":"The first inserts an unsupported expense without showing its calculation; the second calculates a different quantity from the requested employee wage.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00798","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds for the entire cat, omitting the two-ear multiplier.","case2_error":"Omits the 15 cards Rick keeps when calculating the cards given to Miguel.","reason":"The first fails to scale a per-item time by item count; the second omits a separate allocation from a conservation calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00799","case1_error":"Reports each shortened constituent piece's length; the wording ambiguously distinguishes constituent pieces from the joined rope.","case2_error":"Correctly calculates three additional hours but answers with six total hours, calling them additional hours.","reason":"The rope question leaves the requested meaning of 'pieces' materially ambiguous.
